20009.reason: Internal reliability fix for a flaky-test race. Change retries deleteJob on HelixException up to 3 attempts with 1s/2s backoff for both forced and non-forced deletes, rethrowing the last HelixException if all attempts fail; non-HelixException precondition failures still fail immediately. 19838.title: Add per-table SHADOW enforcement mode for storage and query quotas
19838.author: Tarun-kishore
19838.summary: Add per-table quota enforcement modes. New optional QuotaConfig fields storageQuotaEnforcementMode and queryQuotaEnforcementMode (enum QuotaEnforcementMode: DISABLED|SHADOW|ENFORCED; null==ENFORCED, omitted from serialized form). SHADOW detects a breach, records the metric (QUERY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED broker meter / new STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED controller meter) + warning log, but does not reject the query / block offline push / pause realtime consumption. DISABLED skips the check. Storage effective mode is DISABLED if the controller-wide storage check is off. Hybrid table referenced w/o type suffix: strictest configured mode among existing OFFLINE/REALTIME wins. Added in 1.7.0 (master==1.7.0-SNAPSHOT). Documented 2 rows in reference/configuration-reference/table.md#quota and a new Enforcement mode subsection in build-with-pinot/querying-and-sql/query-execution-controls/query-quotas.md.

20097.author: Jackie-Jiang
20097.reason: Internal controller rebalance correctness/performance fix (labels: bug, ingestion, performance, real-time, segment-rebalance; fixes #20095). The fix tracks already force-committed partition group IDs in an IntOpenHashSet for the whole rebalance so each partition's consuming segments are force-committed at most once; successors created by an earlier force commit are no longer re-committed on IdealState version-race retries or later movement steps (removes the old 'shouldForceCommit = false' one-shot-per-outer-iteration flag in favor of per-partition dedup). 20115.title: Add option to require an existing server data directory
20115.author: xiangfu0
20115.summary: Add new server config pinot.server.instance.dataDir.failOnMissing (constant CONFIG_OF_INSTANCE_DATA_DIR_FAIL_ON_MISSING, default DEFAULT_INSTANCE_DATA_DIR_FAIL_ON_MISSING=false). When true, server startup fails (before joining Helix or serving queries) if the instance dataDir is missing, instead of auto-creating it; useful for deployments preparing disks separately. Only the instance dataDir is checked (consumerDir and tier data dirs still created on demand); existing writability check preserved; checks existence only, not disk mount. Enforced in HelixInstanceDataManager.initInstanceDataDir via Preconditions.checkState. Added in 1.7.0. Documented one row in reference/configuration-reference/server.md after pinot.server.instance.dataDir.
